_doc: UCM sourcing posture-lean policy + auto-fill (channel-desk M6, #293). The lean is a preference blend across three axes — margin / condition / vehicle-type(demand-fit) — NOT numeric quotas. The UCM scores the daily auction board against the (normalized) lean and auto-buys the best fits it can afford, with execution-fidelity drift by condition_reading skill (M5). All numbers are placeholders; hard calibration is the S14 balance pass (#286).
